title: Text-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models for Multimodal Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.34206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide transferable numerical forecasting priors. However, forecast-relevant information may be conveyed in text without being reflected in the observed series. Many multimodal forecasting methods integrate such context through model inputs or intermediate representations. We investigate a complementary mechanism: text-conditioned parameter adaptation. We propose Context-to-LoRA for Time Series (C2LoRA-TS), which encodes text and generates temporary Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) updates for selected weight matrices of a frozen TSFM. Both the numerical backbone and text encoder remain frozen, and the method exactly recovers the frozen TSFM output when context is absent. Evaluated on Time-MMD across nine domains and three TSFM architectures, C2LoRA-TS achieves lower aggregate forecasting error than the frozen-TSFM and Static LoRA baselines for every architecture and seed. translated_title: 面向多模态预测的文本条件化时间序列基础模型低秩适应方法
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）提供了可迁移的数值预测先验。然而，与预测相关的信息可能通过文本传达，而并未体现在观测序列中。许多多模态预测方法通过模型输入或中间表示来整合此类上下文信息。我们研究了一种互补机制：文本条件化参数适应。我们提出了面向时间序列的 Context-to-LoRA 方法（C2LoRA-TS），该方法对文本进行编码，并为冻结的时间序列基础模型中选定的权重矩阵生成临时性的低秩适应（LoRA）更新。数值主干网络和文本编码器均保持冻结，且当上下文信息缺失时，该方法能精确恢复冻结 TSFM 的原始输出。在 Time-MMD 数据集上跨九个领域和三种 TSFM 架构的评估中，C2LoRA-TS 在所有架构和随机种子下均比冻结 TSFM 和静态 LoRA 基线取得了更低的总体预测误差。（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出C2LoRA-TS方法，通过将文本上下文编码为冻结时间序列基础模型的临时LoRA参数更新，实现文本条件化的参数适应，在九个领域的多模态预测任务中均优于冻结模型和静态LoRA基线。
en_tdlr: C2LoRA-TS introduces text-conditioned parameter adaptation by encoding text context into temporary LoRA updates for frozen time-series foundation models, achieving lower multimodal forecasting error than frozen-TSFM and Static LoRA baselines across nine domains.
